content:
We have a new stable release of Lean, v4.33.1. See the release notes for more information.

This is a point release containing runtime and kernel fixes, including three soundness fixes; we encourage all users on v4.33.0 or earlier to upgrade.

Mathlib, cslib and doc-gen4 are available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.33.1 tags. We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.33.1 when possible, and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating.
